title: borg-cube work bead
description: A work item produced by the delegation skill. acceptance_criteria and provenance are mandatory; a bead without a testable criterion is rejected by scripts/beads_from_plan.py.

objective.description: One paragraph: what the worker is to achieve and why; defaults to the title

output.description: Format and location of the deliverable, for example 'Markdown report at runs/<id>/report.md with a Findings section'

check.description: A pass/fail check someone other than the owner can run: a command, a file and its expected content, a number

sources.description: Paths, references or beads the worker may read; nothing else is in scope

out_of_scope.description: What the worker must not do and which neighbouring bead owns it

provenance.description: Where the need came from: path plus locator, Message-ID, Mattermost permalink, bead id

effort.description: Budget: approximate tool calls or wall time, for example '20 calls' or '2h'

review_by.description: Role that reviews; must be a tier at least as strong as the owner

escalation.description: When to stop and hand back; defaults to assets/escalation-rules.md

xid.description: External id once created with bd
